subject: Re: Veridian telemetry & SLA telemetry hooks — prioritization request
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Morales <s.morales@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + telemetry ask for contract (Veridian)

Sofia — great to connect last week. Quick follow up from our side: Veridian's procurement team flagged some telemetry requirements they need in order to sign the SOW (auditability of request traces, per-model usage breakdowns, and an extra delivery hook for raw request logs).

I've attached the spreadsheet they sent over (veridian_telemetry_requirements.xlsx) — top asks summarized: 
- Request-level trace IDs propagated into audit logs
- Per-tenant per-model token breakdown on a 1h cadence
- A webhook (POST) for raw request+response payloads to Veridian's collector (signed, retries, and 7d retention)

They're asking whether these are covered by our Dedicated offering or if they require a Private deployment. This is tied to the SOW and the exec sign-off — Veridian's steering committee meets 7/22 and procurement asked for a yes/no decision by 7/19.

Can we get a quick internal read on technical feasibility and an ETA for an MVP plan? Laura — can you confirm whether the CS team sees this as an implementation job on onboarding or a platform feature?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call with product if useful.

— Tessa

Attachment: veridian_telemetry_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46KB)

From: Sofia Morales <s.morales@veridianhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + telemetry ask for contract (Veridian)

Tessa — thanks. Added a short clarifying list inline. Procurement needs explicit confirmation that the following are possible without moving to Private (we prefer Dedicated if feasible):

1) Trace propagation: we need a stable request_id surfaced in exported audit logs (not just internal request ids). Example: our SIEM will ingest logs and match to our own trace ids.
2) Token breakdown: hourly CSV export (or API endpoint) showing tokens per model per tenant.
3) Webhook: POST to https://collector.veridianhealth.com/ingest with HMAC-SHA256 signing, retry/backoff, and delivery status webhooks to our side. 7 days retention on the raw payloads on your side.

We attached the procurement checklist to this thread. If some items are out-of-scope, call them out so we can negotiate in the SOW (credits, implementation hours).

— Sofia

Attachment: procurement_checklist_veridian.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Veridian telemetry & SLA telemetry hooks — prioritization request

Internal — forwarding Veridian's asks (see attached spreadsheet and procurement checklist). Bottom line: this is gating a ~$1.4M ARR deal with committed Dedicated capacity; procurement wants confirmation by 7/19 for the 7/22 steering committee.

Key asks (from their email):
- Propagate a stable request_id into exported audit logs (they'll map to their SIEM)
- Per-tenant, per-model hourly token breakdown (CSV/API)
- A signed webhook for raw request/response payloads with retries + delivery status notifications; 7d retention on our side

Constraints / commercial: Veridian prefers Dedicated (no Private). They want these items explicitly listed in the SOW (I've attached veridian_sow_draft_v3.pdf). Procurement is open to a short-term implementation addendum (one-time engineering hours) if product deems any of this a feature.

Ask: Michael — can you triage whether these are:
A) configuration work we can enable on Dedicated (ops + small infra change) — ETA?
B) product-level features requiring design + 2–3 sprint work (estimate)?

Karthik — if this is ops/config, what level of engineering involvement do you anticipate for a Dedicated rollout? Laura — we may need CS to scope an onboarding services package if it's an implementation rather than a platform capability.

I know the timelines are tight; happy to align on tradeoffs (e.g., initial minimal webhook + 72h retention, then expand).

— Tessa

Attachment: veridian_sow_draft_v3.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Veridian telemetry & SLA telemetry hooks — prioritization request

Thanks for the context — I reviewed the spreadsheet and procurement checklist. Quick assessment:

1) Request_id in exported logs: low effort — we can tag the existing audit export with an external_request_id field and include it in CSV/JSON exports. Ops will need a migration window for the export schema. (Estimate: 3–4 dev days + 1 day infra).

2) Hourly token breakdown per tenant/model: depends on whether we pull from existing usage aggregates or compute from raw tokens. Fast path: generate hourly aggregates from existing metrics pipeline and expose CSV export/API (Estimate: 7–10 dev days + 2 days infra).

3) Signed webhook for raw request/response payloads + 7d retention: this is the heaviest ask. We currently have internal hooks for monitoring but not a customer-facing raw payload delivery with signature + delivery retries. Implementation options:
  - Option A (MVP): provide a minimal webhook with HMAC signing, 72h retention, and best-effort retries. (Estimate: 2–3 sprints, 2 backend devs + 1 infra + 1 QA)
  - Option B (Full): production-grade delivery with guaranteed retries, DLQ, delivery webhooks, audit trails, and 7d retention (Estimate: 4–6 sprints, full infra + security review).

Given the timeline (decision by 7/19), we can commit to evaluating Option A for an interim SOW addendum and schedule Option B for a roadmap slot. I'll open a Jira to track work: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1894

Triage note: If sales needs a firm ETA in time for procurement, we can commit to delivering Option A (MVP webhook + 72h retention) as an engineering task scoped to a short-term project. Product would like approval to treat Option B as a roadmap feature with prioritization against the rest of the Dedicated backlog.

— Michael

Related link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1894

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Veridian telemetry & SLA telemetry hooks — prioritization request

Appreciate the quick triage, Michael. Veridian procurement confirmed they'd accept Option A as an interim commitment if we include an explicit roadmap milestone to Option B in the SOW. That gets us to signature timeline for the 7/22 steering committee.

Action items: 
- Michael: please convert your notes into a short RFC and a proposed deliverable checklist (Option A scope + acceptance criteria). Can you post to INF-1894 before EOD 7/19?
- Karthik & Ops: block a short review slot to validate infra requirements for the 72h MVP (we should capture expected throughput and retention costs).
- Laura: I'll loop CS for onboarding hours estimate and include a line-item in the SOW.

I'll update Veridian's procurement team once we have the RFC link and a one-line commitment for Option A + roadmap milestone. Thanks everyone — moving fast on this one.

— Tessa
